headline_seed: US justice department drops probe into Fed chairman Jerome Powell
description_seed: President Donald Trump had accused Powell of improper cost overruns in renovating the Fed's building.

what: US justice department drops probe into Fed chairman Jerome Powell

clean_source_blocks.text: President Donald Trump had accused Powell of improper cost overruns in renovating the Fed's building.
The US justice department is dropping its investigation into the Federal Reserve chairman, Jerome Powell, over alleged building cost overruns.

US President Donald Trump has said he will fire Jerome Powell if the Federal Reserve chair does not step down “in time”, adding that he will not drop the Justice Department investigation into the central bank leader.
The US Department of Justice is dropping its criminal investigation against Federal Reserve chair Jerome Powell, clearing the path for Donald Trump’s new nominee for chair to be confirmed.
